text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she really is amazing... She's
precise, she's
fast, she's...

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta go talk to her! This is your
chance,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And then, I was told I'd be better suited
to
running with a short stride... And I
thought it'd be
great if I could learn how
to do that from you,
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So you want me to teach you how to run
with a
short stride? You've got great
spirit. Let's get
right to it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The tall staircase here is perfect for
practicing the
Machan stride.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Or at least that's what my trainer said.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Y-you really think so? Hehe... That's
good...
choice_data_list: You're not losing your edge anymore!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know it was possible to improve
on the
Machan stride.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You know what this means, right?
My
running will definitely be burned into
people's
memories now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: Let's show them an unforgettable run!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, this training is supposed
to be
secret.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm honing an unforgettable running
style with my
trainer, you see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But since you two have such discerning
eyes, I'll
let you be my special witnesses,
okay?
